rationale: Live is inductively rooted at initialized local slots and closed through initialized fields of reached objects. State.collect filters existing entries by Live and Configuration.collect uses projected active locals or []. It changes only objects, preserving frame, counter and surviving entries. With no locals Live.has_variable excludes every live object, establishing empty-heap collection. The unit explicitly states whole-statement boundaries and noncomputability; these boundaries are specified by the following Step unit.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Proof correctness is checked separately by Lean; the correspondence review compares statements, definitions and example propositions.
Abstract syntax and mathematical GC are modeled; no parser or executable collector is certified. Functions safety permits divergence.
